create_multitask_criterion: create a MultitaskCriterion instance with multitask tasks and an rdrop_alpha regularization value
set_multitask_loss_weight: set the loss weight for a specific multitask task name in the MultitaskCriterion
get_multitask_loss: compute the combined multitask loss across all registered task criteria using the model and sample
build_speech_to_unit_criterion: build a SpeechToUnitMultitaskTaskCriterion for speech-to-unit training with label smoothing and RDrop support
build_speech_to_spectrogram_criterion: build a SpeechToSpectrogramMultitaskTaskCriterion for speech-to-spectrogram training with Tacotron2 loss and guided attention
